notes: Costs money. The program also runs 6-week online courses in winter and summer. See the program site for those. Questions: iyws@uiowa.edu or 319-335-4209.
name: Iowa Young Writers' Studio Summer Residential Program
org: University of Iowa, Iowa Young Writers' Studio
what_you_do: Spend two weeks on campus studying one kind of writing, such as poetry, fiction, playwriting or TV writing. You learn from students and graduates of the Iowa Writers' Workshop.
who_can_apply: Students who are in 10th, 11th or 12th grade when they apply. Students from outside the United States may apply. Students in 9th grade can no longer apply.
pay_detail: $2,500 for one 2-week session in 2027 (room, board and teaching included). There is a $10 reading fee to apply, and it can be waived. Need-based financial aid is offered.
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 25, 2027 and close Feb 7, 2027 (11:59 PM Central). Summer 2027 sessions are June 13 to 26 and July 11 to 24.
how_to_apply: Apply online on Submittable during the two-week window. Send a writing sample of up to ten pages. Also send a statement of purpose of 1 to 2 pages. Ask an English or writing teacher, tutor or mentor to upload one letter of recommendation. Decisions go out by email on April 9, 2027.
